subject: Approval runway & buying sprint: next steps and signoffs
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ava Balakrishnan <ava@healthnexus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval runway & buying sprint: next steps and signoffs

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed short sprint to get to POC approval: 

Summary of what you said:
- Primary use: clinical notes summarization and triage alerts for outpatient clinics (avg. 150 tokens/request).
- Success criteria: 95% precision on triage flags for top-3 priority conditions, integration with Epic sandbox, and <50ms median token latency at 1k RPS for streaming summaries.
- Internal blockers: procurement needs a short procurement packet, security wants SOC2 evidence + KMS details, and the CFO needs a cost run for a reserved 3-month trial.

Proposed short sprint (3 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week) — finalize POC scope + stakeholder signoffs (economic buyer + security owner).
2) Week 1 — Redwood to deliver POC scoping doc, security appendix, and cost estimate for reserved capacity.
3) Week 2 — Integration checklist execution in Epic sandbox; final signoff meeting for go/no-go.

Immediate asks for your team (can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?):
- Who is the economic approver that signs budget for trials? (Name & email)
- Who will own security evidence review (SOC2/HIPAA contact)?
- Any procurement template or PO flow we should follow?

I attached a compact \"approval-runway-compact.xlsx\" that maps approvals we typically see — we can iterate it together. Also attached: POC scope v1 and a brief security evidence appendix.

If that plan looks reasonable I’ll circulate a one-page mutual plan with owners and tentative dates for your approval.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 415-555-0198
https://redwood.com/company

Attachments: HN-POC-scope-v1.pdf (POC scope draft), approval-runway-compact.xlsx (approval matrix), redwood-security-evidence-appendix.pdf (SOC2 summary, KMS notes)

From: Ava Balakrishnan <ava@healthnexus.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthnexus.com>, CFO Office <cfo@healthnexus.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval runway & buying sprint: next steps and signoffs

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear recap and timeline. High level confirmation and answers below: 

Economic approver: Priya Menon (VP, Product Finance) — priya.menon@healthnexus.com. Priya will own the budget signoff for the POC.
Security owner: Daniel Cho (Lead InfoSec) — daniel.cho@healthnexus.com. He’ll need SOC2 Type II report + KMS/HSM integration details and will run the evidence checklist.
Procurement flow: please route initial billing/contract to procurement@healthnexus.com; their standard PO form is attached in this reply. They typically require a 30-day review once legal sees the contract.

A couple of clarifications from our side: 
- The CFO would like a line-item estimate for a 3-month reserved trial (GPU-backed) at the throughput you mentioned.
- Security will also ask about data retention and audit logs — a short note on what Redwood logs and retention defaults would be helpful.

We’d be happy to have the POC scoping doc by Friday. If you can include an owner column in that compact spreadsheet that will make internal routing easier.

Best,
Ava Balakrishnan
Director of Clinical Programs | HealthNexus

Attachment: HN_PO_Requirements_Template.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ava Balakrishnan <ava@healthnexus.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@healthnexus.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval runway & buying sprint: next steps and signoffs

Thanks Ava — and nice to meet you virtually. Quick internal note and ask: 

Karthik / Jordan — I took Ava’s answers and sketched a compact mutual sprint below so we have something concrete to share with Priya and Daniel. I’m putting owners on each line so procurement/legal can triage faster.

Compact mutual sprint (proposal):
- Task A: Budget estimate for 3-month reserved trial — owner: Karthik — due: Fri 3/17
- Task B: Security evidence package (SOC2 report + KMS notes + retention summary) — owner: Jordan — due: Fri 3/17
- Task C: POC scope doc with integration checklist and test cases — owner: Marissa — due: Fri 3/17
- Task D: Draft contract addendum & PO form prep — owner: Legal (cc procurement) — due: Mon 3/20
- Task E: Signoff meeting with Priya & Daniel — owner: Ava (coordinate schedule) — target: Thu 3/23

A few practical notes: 
- Jordan: can you include a short retention table (default retention, options, and audit log availability)?
- Karthik: I’ll prepare a one-page owner roster we can attach to the procurement PO to speed routing.

Ava — if the dates look tight we can push the internal due dates by a week; wanted to give an aggressive but realistic path. Will produce the one-page MAP (owner + dates + acceptance criteria) once we have the three deliverables above.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Per our internal sprint, please find attached: 
- HN-POC-scope-v1.pdf (finalized scope with integration checklist and acceptance tests)
- approval-runway-compact.xlsx (owner roster + target dates)
- redwood-security-evidence-appendix.pdf (SOC2 summary, KMS notes, retention table)

Key highlights: 
- Cost estimate: 3-month reserved trial (4x A100-class instances, estimated token volumes shown) = $74,500 total (line items in the spreadsheet).
- Retention: default 30 days for transient request logs; audit logs retained 365 days with role-based access; customer can request configurable retention for enterprise contracts.
- Signoff asks: Priya — please confirm if the cost estimate aligns with your budget envelope or if you need an alternate configuration. Daniel — please confirm if the provided SOC2 summary and KMS details are sufficient to begin your evidence checklist.

Next steps: 
- If Priya/Daniel are comfortable, Ava — can you propose 30/45-minute windows next week for the signoff meeting (target Thu 3/23)?
- We’ll pause legal/PO drafting until we get confirmation from the economic approver and security owner on the POC scope & estimate.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to moving quickly.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
